process.title: Discovery Call
process.description: We dig into what you're actually trying to solve — not just what you're asking for. Free, no commitment. If Altorz isn't the fit, I'll say so on the call.

process.title: Scope & Proposal
process.description: I document deliverables, timeline, and price in writing. You approve, we proceed. No surprises.

process.title: Data & Design
process.description: I map your data sources, design the ribbon architecture, and share wireframes for sign-off before building.

process.title: Build & Iterate
process.description: I build in milestones. You see progress every 2–3 days, give feedback, and we adjust as we go - not at the end.

process.title: Test & Validate
process.description: Stress tests against edge cases, real dataset sizes, and refresh failures. Every Altorz systems ships Production-grade, not prototype-grade.

process.title: Delivery + Handover
process.description: Ribbon installation on your teams's laptops, walkthrough call, recorded video tutorial, and a formal SOP documentation. You and your team can actually run it without me.

process.title: 30-45 Day Support
process.description: Free bug fixes, tweaks, and questions for 30-45 days post-delivery (project-dependent). After that, optional AMC retainer for ongoing changes.

whyMe.title: Production-grade, not prototype-grade
whyMe.description: Every Altorz system is deliverable is documented, error-handled, and built to outlive the person who made it. If your team can't run it after I leave, I haven't done my job.

whyMe.title: Fast turnaround without compromise
whyMe.description: Most dashboards ship in 5-10 days. Full systems in 10-14. I don't pad timelines — I just don't quote what I can't deliver.

whyMe.title: Delivered as installed software, not files
whyMe.description: Every system ships through the Altorz Ribbon™ — a branded add-in installed on your team's Excel. One-click access to every automation. Not a scattered set of macro files.

whyMe.title: NDA-friendly, data-confidential
whyMe.description: I sign NDAs, use anonymized datasets when possible, and treat your data like my own. No sub-contractors, no outsourcing — I build everything myself.

whyMe.title: Built to scale with your business
whyMe.description: Power Query, modular ribbon structures, named ranges, version-controlled. When your data grows 10x, your tools shouldn't crack.

whyMe.title: Responsive, available, human
whyMe.description: Replies under 4 hours during business days. Direct WhatsApp line to me, not a support ticket queue. Weekly check-ins. No ghosting, no surprises, no excuses.

whyMe.title: Insider-built, not textbook-built
whyMe.description: I work full-time inside a B2B manufacturing operation. Every Altorz system is built with real operator knowledge.

whyMe.title: 100% delivery rate
whyMe.description: Every project I've taken on has shipped on spec. I'd rather decline work than over-promise.

pricing.note: Pricing is indicative. Final pricing depends on scope, complexity, data sources, and timeline. Every project receives a written proposal after a discovery call and before work begins.

faqs.q: How do you usually price projects?
faqs.a: Fixed price by scope, not hourly. After a 30-min discovery call I send a written proposal with deliverables, timeline, and price. You approve before any work starts.

Altorz serves SMEs and growing businesses across a wide range of industries, including manufacturing, distribution & wholesale, retail, logistics & transportation, real estate, professional services, healthcare, FMCG, construction, and B2B businesses. Our Excel, MIS, dashboard, automation, and data solutions are customized to each business's workflows, reporting requirements, and operational needs.

It's the delivery methodology — every Altorz system ships as a branded Excel add-in installed on your team's laptops. Your team gets one-click access to every automation under a dedicated tab named after your business. It's the difference between a 'macro file' that dies in three months and a system that lives in your operations.
Templates and Data cleaning: 2-5 days. Dashboards: 2-3 weeks. Full systems and financial models: 3-4 weeks. AMC Retainer: work begins within 48 hours of signup. Rush delivery available at +25%.
Yes, always — for any client who requests it. Your data, business logic, and methodologies stay confidential. I work alone, so there are no sub-contractors involved in any Altorz project.

faqs.q: What happens if I need changes after delivery?
faqs.a: Every project includes 30-45 days of free post-delivery support (depending on tier) — bug fixes, small tweaks, and questions. After that, an optional retainer covers ongoing changes.

faqs.q: Can my team actually maintain what you build?
faqs.a: Yes — that's the standard I build to. Every project includes documentation, a recorded video walkthrough, and a handover call. If your team can't run it without me, I haven't done my job.

faqs.q: What if my data is really messy?
faqs.a: That's literally what Altorz does. Tally exports, disconnected branch spreadsheets, inconsistent formats — Power Query was built for exactly this. Send a sample and I'll tell you on the discovery call what's salvageable and what needs to be restructured.

faqs.q: Can you upgrade an existing spreadsheet instead of starting fresh?
faqs.a: Often — but not always. I'll review what you have and recommend honestly. Sometimes rebuilding is cheaper than patching a broken foundation.
